reason: Reviewed lifecycle-hook guidance, the Notifai skill and its references, harness setup, CLI readiness, and domain/trust terms against the per-harness reference split. The harness setup reference carried every harness's activation and answer-return mechanics in one file, so an agent installing or diagnosing one harness read all seven. Each harness now has its own reference file holding its activation paragraph and, where it has one, its answer-return paragraph, moved verbatim. The setup reference keeps what every harness shares and an index that tells the agent to read only the file for the harness it is in. Claude Code command approval moved from the shared install section into the Claude Code file, and the OpenClaw missing-context paragraph moved from notes and edits into the OpenClaw file behind a pointer. One sentence changed meaning: a busy Claude Code session receives a wake-up between tool calls or when its turn ends, which is what Claude Code documents and what was measured, where the text said only at turn end. No command, flag, setup step, trust decision, question identity or acknowledgement obligation changes.
